name: ECOCO Desktop Tissue Box Organizer Toilet Paper Towel Storage Holder
description:
ECOCO Desktop Tissue Box Organizer – Waterproof & Multi-Purpose 🏠✨

Upgrade your home or office setup with the ECOCO Desktop Tissue Box Organizer. Designed with a sleek, modern look, it not only holds your tissues but also works as a convenient storage solution.

✅ Features:

Brand: Ecoco

Material: Durable plastic, waterproof & long-lasting

Multi-Purpose Use: Suitable for living room, bathroom, office, or car

Applicable Tissue: Removable tissues

Style: Modern simplicity with a clean, elegant finish

Color Options: Gray / Blue / Pink

✅ Specifications:

Model: Desktop Tissue Box

Dimensions: Compact & space-saving (approx. 21 × 16 cm)

Origin: Guangzhou

Functions: Waterproof, tissue storage + small item organizer

Applicable Occasions: Perfect for daily use or as a thoughtful gift (housewarming, promotions, etc.)
